capabilities: Insert person links from a mobile picker (people, groups, ghosts, create-new)
Insert location links from a picker
Append deduplicated wikilinks to people: and locations: frontmatter lists on insert
Expand inserted groups into their member links in frontmatter
Migrate flat people notes into a per-person folder structure
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a journaling or daily-notes tool; it only inserts entity wikilinks, tracks mentions, and migrates a people folder.
extras: Commands register only on phones/tablets, not desktop. Data access is limited to configured entity folders and the active note; nothing is sent to external servers. Pre-release builds are installable via BRAT, and release assets include GitHub artifact attestations.
problem: Adding wikilinks to people and places while journaling on a phone is slow, and keeping frontmatter mention lists up to date must be done by hand.

relations.evidence: Works with Obsidian Properties and Dataview (FLATTEN people, contains(people, [[Joy]]), etc.).

summary: Mobile-only plugin that inserts person, group, and location wikilinks via pickers and auto-tracks mentions in frontmatter lists.
